title: 제인 에어
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the personification of «제인 에어» (romance). Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

SYMBOL (this one only, as an accessory or an object in the scene — never printed on or woven into the clothes): "붉은 방".

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her book shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never her form costume, never a carried book. Era, place, activity, outfit, pose and camera follow SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; the Framing in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

WORLD: this scene happens inside the world of «제인 에어», as if she simply lives there — the windswept moors near Haworth, a stone parsonage wall and heather. Its architecture, props, light and weather show the world; no characters or creatures from the story, no text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: the place named in WORLD
Activity: comparing a folded map with the way ahead
Outfit: a sleeveless linen dress with a belted waist
Pose: Stand at ease with relaxed shoulders and naturally balanced feet.
Orientation: torso and pelvis face the camera; gaze is independent
Framing: Full-body framing: keep the complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins.
Lens / perspective: 24mm-equivalent wide-angle impression with spacious environmental depth; use enough camera distance to avoid stretching the face or limbs.
Expression: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: subtle — her book shows only as one small accessory; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: strongly prefer separates — use separate top and bottom by default; a garment named in the chosen Outfit takes priority

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her book belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her and never a character from her book. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.
